intro: Guinea-Bissau won independence from Portugal through a long liberation war led by Amílcar Cabral.

chapters.title: Kaabu
text: The region was part of the Kaabu kingdom, linked to the Mali Empire. Portuguese traders arrived in the 1400s and Cacheu became a slave-trading post.

chapters.title: Liberation war
text: From 1963 the PAIGC, led by Amílcar Cabral, fought Portuguese rule. Cabral was assassinated in 1973, months before independence was declared. Portugal recognised it in 1974.

highlight.title: Amílcar Cabral
highlight.text: A thinker and leader honoured across Africa.

chapters.title: Since independence
text: The country has had many coups and coup attempts. In November 2025 the military seized power again during the election count.

keyTerms.meaning: The party that led the independence war.
